nodes.name: architecture-avoid-boolean-props.md
nodes.summary: Rule guidance on avoiding boolean prop proliferation in React components, recommending variant/enum-based APIs instead of multiple boolean flags.

nodes.name: architecture-compound-components.md
nodes.summary: Rule guidance on using the compound components pattern to build flexible, composable React component APIs instead of monolithic components with many props.

nodes.name: patterns-children-over-render-props.md
nodes.summary: Rule guidance recommending the use of children composition over render props for passing rendering logic into React components.

nodes.name: patterns-explicit-variants.md
nodes.summary: Rule guidance on creating explicit, named component variants rather than overloading a single component with conditional prop-driven behavior.

nodes.name: react19-no-forwardref.md
nodes.summary: Rule guidance on React 19 API changes, specifically that `ref` can now be passed as a regular prop, removing the need for `forwardRef`.

nodes.name: state-context-interface.md
nodes.summary: Rule guidance on defining generic, dependency-injectable Context interfaces in React to decouple consumers from concrete state implementations.

nodes.name: state-decouple-implementation.md
nodes.summary: Rule guidance on decoupling state management logic from UI components to improve reusability and testability.

nodes.name: state-lift-state.md
nodes.summary: Rule guidance on lifting shared state into provider components to avoid prop drilling and centralize state ownership.
